svg.title: PinballCTL wooden bench — overhead placement and harness key

g.text: Overhead placement on a 460 × 310 mm pine box • Supplier photos show parts before mounting • Positions are approximate
REAR / USB AND DC CABLE ENTRY
12 V jack → fuse bank → upright rear DIN converter
Converter 5 V → separate pixel fuses • common 0 V
LCD + I²C shifter | MMA8452Q | AHCT buffer
Two MOSFET drivers → two amber output lamps
5 V power to each fused branch
FRONT / SWITCH PLATE • group photos identify the control types
Jack + → fused 12 V branches → converter and
Four separately fused 30-pixel rows. Join data
DOUT → DIN at each turn. Keep + feeds separate.
ESP 3V3 → COM → closed NO → assigned GPIO.
Arcade buttons use their two switch terminals.
GPIO1 → toggle common. BALL HELD throw → GND.
EMPTY throw stays open. Boot in EMPTY for AUTO.
GPIO6 left, GPIO7 right → respective driver IN.
Lamp + and − → same driver’s output terminals.
Join ESP GND, driver GND and converter returns.
Run pixel load returns separately to the return block.
Shooter 4 • Entry 10 • Lock 11 • Ramp 13 • Orbit 15 • Standup 16 • Skill 21 • Start 42 • Launch 39 • Right flipper 38
Pops 1 / 2 → GPIO17 / 47. Park Pop 3 (GPIO48, onboard RGB) and left flipper (GPIO37, R8 PSRAM) until the board mapping is verified.
* APEM publishes a generic 5000-series image on the exact part listing. Identify the actual common and throw pins by continuity before wiring.
Photos: Freenove • Arcade Parts UK • RS / Omron • Hobby Components • APEM. Click a photo in the SVG to open its listing.
